result.description:
About the company

Statewide Bearings is a proudly 100% Australian-owned and operated family business, with over 50 years of expertise in the bearing and power transmission industry. As one Australia’s leading suppliers in this field, we have offices located across the country, with more than 44 locations and a team of over 500 employees nationwide. As a family owned and operated business we are committed to our people. At SWB, we prioritise our employees, promoting a supportive and inclusive work environment where every team member feels valued and has the opportunity to grow.

About the role

We are currently seeking a motivated Sales Representative to join our Statewide Bearings team Wind Energy Team in Dandenong!
In your role, you will be responsible for supporting growth of our Wind Energy division by delivering technical service solutions, undertaking maintenance activities both in the workshop and at third-party sites, providing engineering support, and coordinating workshop and onsite service activities, while providing an exceptional level of customer service and satisfaction to all SWB customers and internal stakeholders.
This is a full-time position that offers excellent career prospects working alongside a highly motivated team. As a Sales Representative, you will report to the Wind Energy Manager and work closely with our Wind Energy Team.

About the Position

Position: Sales Representative (Industrial Products)

Location of work: 84 Greens Road, Dandenong South, VIC 3175

Employment type: Permanent, Full time.

Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus Superannuation.

Key Responsibilities

•	Work closely with customers, engineers, and technical teams to assess equipment needs and recommend suitable products or system solutions.
•	Collaborate with sales teams to assess customer needs and recommend suitable wind energy solutions.
•	Promote the SWB Wind engineering and product capabilities.
•	Provide technical presentations and product demonstrations to prospective clients.
•	Prepare quotations, negotiate pricing, and manage the full sales cycle including order placement, contract negotiation, and delivery coordination.
•	Assist in preparing proposals, bids, projects and responses to RFQs.
•	Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshooting for clients.
•	Conduct routine inspections and maintenance to ensure optimal turbine performance.
•	Train clients and internal teams on operation and maintenance procedures.
•	Schedule jobs in house and with third party suppliers.
•	Control job schedules, timelines and deadlines.
•	Work at assigned Wind Farm or workshop locations as required.
•	Promote and deliver cost effective process, solutions and savings.

To be successful in the role the applicant will need:

•	A relevant bachelor’s degree (required).
•	At least one year of experience in a similar role
•	Strong technical understanding of industrial products, machinery, and mechanical systems.
•	he ability to interpret technical drawings & schematics, and complete detailed inspection & QA reports.
•	The ability to understand and respond effectively to customer needs.
•	Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
•	High level of experience in Microsoft Excel and Word.
•	A proactive, self – motivated, and highly organised with excellent time management skills.
•	A high level of professionalism.
•	Current Driver’s License.
•	Access to a Personal Vehicle for site travel (Essential).

If you are looking to join a supportive work environment where you can grow and become the best version of yourself, apply now and start your career with SWB!

To apply, please click on the “Apply Now” button and submit both your resume and covering letter.

result.description:
ICM Agribusiness (Peechelba Beef) are currently looking to recruit experienced and qualified Plant Operator to join their team in Peechelba VIC.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

-  Preparing and positioning plant for operation 
-  Operating tractor drawn and self-propelled plant to plough land and sow, fertilise, cultivate and harvest crops, and avoid damaging crops. 
-  Calibrating and monitoring plant performance, including adjusting speed, height and depth of implements as well as distribution or collection rates as needed. 
-  Operating plant to conduct farm and feedlot operations
-  Identify the appropriate machine for the task being performed.
-  Keeping production and work records and writing reports
-  Servicing plant and performing minor repairs
-  Conduct pre-start checks on all machinery and ensure all machinery is running efficiently.
-  Operate machinery efficiently to remove manure from pens, around the fertiliser processing area and out on the farm. 
-  Operate machinery efficiently within the Feeds area, loading trucks, sorting commodities and processing rations. 
-  Assist with the implementation of internal policies and procedures to ensure that efficient feeding is conducted on a day-to-day basis.
-  Use the appropriate attachments for the task such as buckets, hay forks, bunk sweep and bunk blower attachments.
-  Use the appropriate plant to turn windrows in the manure composting area and throughout the drying process including screening fertiliser to ensure impurities are removed. 
-  Load trucks with processed fertiliser for spreading on the farm and crop paddocks or to sell to external farmers for their crop paddocks or the home gardener. 
-  Load trucks with the appropriate ration and amount of ration for each load to feed all cattle on the farm/feedlot.
-  Ensure a high standard of presentation is maintained around the farm/feedlot.
-  Ensuring all plant (stationary or moving) are presented as clean as reasonably possible.  
-  Maximise the sustainable return from the land, capital, commodity, plant, equipment and water assets used with that department.
-  To follow all required Work Health and Safety policies and procedures while operating plant and equipment. 


Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications

-  One year of experience operating large broadacre farming machinery and/or earth moving equipment.
-  Demonstrated ability to work as part of a team. 
-  Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision when required.
-  An ability to follow set protocols and ensure compliance with relevant animal welfare, safety, and QA requirements.

Salary range is $69,000-$80,000pa commensurate with experience

Fulltime Positions available
 
Applications open on 23rd July 2026 and closes on 23rd August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

About Us
Simmonds Steel is a leading structural steel supplier and fabricator servicing residential, commercial, industrial and mining projects throughout Western Australia. We provide structural steel solutions ranging from small residential applications to large-scale commercial and industrial developments, including design support, 3D modelling, fabrication and installation services.
We are seeking an experienced and motivated Construction Estimator to join our team on a full-time basis.
Position Overview
Responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates and tender submissions for structural steel fabrication and installation projects. The role involves analysing engineering and architectural documentation, calculating material and labour requirements, obtaining supplier and subcontractor pricing, and supporting project delivery through effective cost planning and estimating. Involvement in tender settlement, cost planning, supplier negotiations, and project budget forecasting
Key Duties and Responsibilities
•	Review and interpret structural, architectural and engineering drawings, specifications and tender documentation.
•	Perform detailed quantity take-offs for structural steel components, including beams, columns, lintels, bracing systems, platework and associated materials.
•	Calculate project costs, including materials, fabrication, labour, transport, craneage, installation and subcontractor services.
•	Prepare accurate cost estimates, quotations, budgets and tender submissions for residential, commercial, industrial and mining projects.
•	Liaise with engineers, architects, project managers, clients and contractors to clarify project requirements and specifications.
•	Assess project risks, site conditions and construction methodologies affecting project costs and delivery.
•	Prepare and maintain estimating databases, cost records and pricing schedules.
•	Assist management in tender reviews, contract negotiations and project handovers.
•	Monitor market pricing trends for steel products, fabrication processes and construction services.
•	Support project planning by providing cost forecasts, material schedules and estimating reports.
•	Ensure all estimates comply with relevant Australian Standards, building codes, safety requirements and company procedures.
Skills and Experience
•	Diploma, Advanced Diploma or higher qualification in Building, Construction, Engineering or a related discipline.
•	Minimum 3 years’ relevant experience as a Construction Estimator, Steel Estimator, Building Estimator or similar role.
•	Strong ability to read and interpret structural and engineering drawings.
•	Experience estimating structural steel fabrication and installation projects.
•	Sound knowledge of construction methods, steel products and fabrication processes.
•	Proficiency with estimating software, Microsoft Excel and construction management systems.
•	Ability to manage multiple tenders and meet deadlines.
What We Offer
•	Full-time permanent position.
•	Competitive salary package of $90000.00 per annum plus superannuation
•	Supportive and professional working environment.
•	Career growth within an established structural steel business.
If you have the skills and experience to contribute to our growing team, we encourage you to apply.
